answer: Artifact filing stops bulk fakes: each identity files one unique artifact. The artifact is a yield log from its orchard, with harvests only it could produce. The log is velvet-bound, its serial in a public vault audited each epoch. An onyx seal binds the log to the key; a rented-log ring copying one log burns the 70-credit bond. Filing costs 45: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep their share.
